name: Implement a UCC-style ansatz by hand in Qiskit: the double-excitation rotation e
task_prompt: Implement a UCC-style ansatz by hand in Qiskit: the double-excitation rotation exp(-i theta/2 (X0 Y1 - Y0 X1)/... ) simplified to a Givens rotation between |01> and |10>, optimize theta with scipy for the Hamiltonian H = 1.12 (X0 X1 + Y0 Y1)/2 + 0.37 (Z0 - Z1)/2 and compare with exact diagonalization. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
